sources.name: PowerPyx
sources.detail: Trophy Guide & Roadmap + All Meditation Spot Locations

sources.name: Beebom / Push Square / Insider Gaming
sources.detail: Supporting: 100% checklist numbers, platinum time estimates

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies first — this Platinum pops on its own the moment the last one lands.
On Xbox the same milestone is a Mythic achievement worth 0G instead of a Platinum.
Open the 100% checklist in Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once the story is done.

Work through the 35 tasks on that checklist — stunts, challenges, vehicles, animals, weapons, card sets, vaults, gang operations, shooting ranges, drone races, Bret's quests, meditations and optional missions.
Progress made before the credits still counts toward the checklist, so early exploring is never wasted.
Push Square's launch-week estimate runs to 300+ hours for the full Platinum; treat that as an estimate, not a measured time.
The checklist is the long road: most of it fills in while you chase the other trophies, and only the leftovers need a dedicated sweep.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Finish the final story mission and this gold trophy pops.
Sources disagree on the chapter: PowerPyx files the final mission under “Starting From Zero”, the last Chapter 4 mission; other sources describe it as Chapter 5, and eGamers notes the split.
No extra action is needed: story trophies cannot be missed, and the final mission is reachable in every playthrough.
Complete 250 stunts anywhere in Leonida — jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count.
The 100% checklist wants 300 of the 397 stunts in the game: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Track your count in Progress > Activities > Stunts, and press R3 to see it per region.
Use the map filter for Stunt Spots to find the ones you have not tried yet.
Stunts stack up fastest while you travel between other goals — take the jump instead of the road whenever you see one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.

steps.t: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 gold medals across 12 range locations.
The same 42 gold medals are also a line on the 100% checklist, so this trophy and the checklist share the work.
Practice the slow challenges first: a steady aim matters more than speed once the targets speed up.
Ranges unlock as you explore; clear each new range to gold before moving on so none is left for the end.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

steps.t: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida.
Four strands are confirmed to count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape search), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries).
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward the eight — their strands belong to other trophies.
Yago's strand is timed (hourglass icon, Chapter 3) — save first, then race him.
Check the progress counter after each strand finishes, so a strand that did not count shows up early.
PowerPyx notes more strangers may still be undiscovered, so the confirmed list above may grow — the counter is the truth, not any list.
Complete 3 Collectible Card sets.
The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets in the game, so keep collecting past the trophy.
Card sets are found across Leonida; pick up every set you pass while doing other goals.
Three sets is the trophy, fifteen is the checklist — the same hunting fills both, so do not stop at three.
WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida.
The count breaks down as 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, with more than 100 scannable spots in total.
Scan with the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up + R1) whenever you pass a landmark.
Scanning is the habit that feeds three trophies at once — locations here, vehicles for Whip It Good, animals for the checklist.
Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape.
There are 8 vaults in total, and the 100% checklist wants all 8 — five is the trophy, eight is the sweep.
Vault robberies open with the optional Chapter 4 mission “That's Where The Money Is…”.
Each vault puts you straight on a 4-star wanted level, so plan the escape route before you walk in.
Bank runs also feed Hot Together and Dime on the Dollar — one vault can pay up to $205,000 in marked bills.
Complete the opening story mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1.
It pops automatically from story progress — no extra action is needed.
One of the 12 story trophies in the 28-hidden set; it pops from story progress and cannot be missed.
Complete Chapter 1.
It pops after the first Chapter 2 mission, “What's in the Bag?”.
No extra action is needed: this trophy pops from story progress alone and cannot be missed.
Complete Chapter 2.
It pops after the first Chapter 3 mission, “Welcome to Vice City”.
No extra action is needed: this trophy pops from story progress alone and cannot be missed.
Complete Chapter 3.
It pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions, “Ocean Beach” and “Another Life”.
No extra action is needed: this trophy pops from story progress alone and cannot be missed.
Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.
Breakfast Run also unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia.
No extra action is needed: this trophy pops from story progress alone and cannot be missed.
Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist.
The heist is a story beat — reach it by playing the Chapter 3 missions in order.
No extra action is needed: this trophy pops from story progress alone and cannot be missed.
Complete Chapter 4.
It pops after the last Chapter 4 mission, “Starting From Zero”.
No extra action is needed: this trophy pops from story progress alone and cannot be missed.
Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play.
Reach it by playing the Chapter 4 missions in order.
No extra action is needed: this trophy pops from story progress alone and cannot be missed.
Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners.
Reach it by playing the Chapter 4 missions in order.
No extra action is needed: this trophy pops from story progress alone and cannot be missed.
Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.
Reach it by playing the Chapter 4 missions in order.
No extra action is needed: this trophy pops from story progress alone and cannot be missed.
Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory.
OutputLag places this mission in Chapter 5.
No extra action is needed: this trophy pops from story progress alone and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.

steps.t: Finish Andy's final mission — from Chapter 3, after Andy calls you.
Head to his house in Belville to start the chain.

Work through the 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (retrieve the Cellerica Van) and Puff Puff Pass (meet at the warehouse).
The chain is Lucia-only, so switch to Lucia before you start — Andy's calls will not come to Jason.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.

steps.t: Finish Kenton's final mission — from Chapter 1, after “Island Dreams (Work for Kenton)”.
Kenton calls, then follow the green “KR” icon to Key Lento and dive the 7 shipwrecks for treasure with a metal detector.
Track progress in Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
The chain goes quiet after Chapter 1 and comes back in Chapters 2–3; phoning Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds its return.
Dive every wreck you pass — the treasure hunt is the whole chain, and the metal detector marks each find.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.

steps.t: Finish Billy's final mission — after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County to meet Billy's crew.
Work through the 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes.
Billy's chain starts at the Mudclub, not on the phone — drive out to Kelly County once Coffee Break is done.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.

steps.t: Finish Randy's final mission — after the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy)”, which unlocks the Key Cloner.

Deliver the 16 sports cars on “Randy's Wish List” — the Zorrusso is automatic, plus the Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee and Baller ST-D.
Follow the green “RK” icon west of Vice City; the cars turn up most often in east Vice City, Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
Track the list in Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List and scan cars with WAiNK; deliver them in good condition for better pay.
Sixteen cars is the longest delivery list in the game — grab every wish-list car you spot while doing other jobs.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.

steps.t: Finish Tyrone's final mission — Jason only, after the Chapter 3 mission “Here, Kitty Kitty”.
Follow the purple markers to the Synthetic Labs in Vice City and destroy them (“Take Out Kitty Litter”).
Finish the “Spin On This” quest (Shut Down the Labs) to close the chain.
Tyrone's chain is Jason-only — switch to Jason before you hunt the labs.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.

steps.t: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — Jason only, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Bret Vogel texts you about “Veteran Hunted” in Lummox County; pick up the unique rifle “Killtelligence SM-69” from an Ammu-Nation weapon locker.
Which animal unlocks the trophy is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx says the exact animal is undergoing confirmation, so do not chase a guessed target.
Bret's 15 Target Decks are all needed for the 100% checklist, so the hunt feeds the checklist even while the trophy animal stays unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

steps.t: Try each of the 9 activity types once.
The first five are: Fishing, Hunting, Golf, Shooting Range and Pool.
The last four are: Basketball, Playing a Video Game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun Drone Race) and performing a stunt.
Track them in Progress > Activities.
Use the map filter “Activities” (blue dumbbell icons) to find each type near you.
Discover 100 vehicles.
Scanning with WAiNK is enough — you do not need to drive them.
The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, from 557 vehicles in total.
Scan every new vehicle you pass — the count fills in while you travel between other goals.
Explore all of Leonida — clear the map fog completely.
The fog lifts as you travel; the fastest way to clear it is by plane.
Check the map: any fogged corner means a region is still unexplored.
Fold the flight into other travel — fly between goals instead of driving and the map clears itself.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.t: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
After the Chapter 1 mission “Feng Shui (Meet Cal)”, Cal texts you and a purple icon marks his spot.
Follow his fishing questline through to the challenge.
Complete an arcade game.
Four games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind (playable on the home TV from Chapter 1) plus Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines out in the world.
“Complete” means finishing every level once — the extra challenges are not needed.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

steps.t: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation FIRST: after the Chapter 1 mission “Down to Earth” (Meet Brian), talk to Lucia in Jason's kitchen in the morning; she says she will meditate, walks to the balcony by the workout gear, and an optional-quest pop-up appears — look at her and choose Accept.
Keep one Chapter 1 manual save until this trophy pops; if the balcony meditation turns out not to be required, the worst case is replaying to Chapter 2.
After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break unlocks character switching, each outdoor spot counts for both characters — meditate at a spot once as Jason and once as Lucia.
Visit the first five named spots: Jason's House (balcony, Ch1), Smooth Sand (Mariana County), Swamp (Kelly County), Worn Stone (Kelly County) and Red Rocks (Kelly County).

Visit the last five: Water Wheel (Lummox County), Jutting Cliff (Lummox County), Waterfall (Lummox County), Seaside (Leonard County) and Ascent Mountain (Mount Kalaga summit, marked only after the other meditations are done).
Track progress in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations and use the map filter Map > Exploration > Meditate Around Leonida (purple icons near each spot).
Dispute — 18 vs 15: the trophy is reported to need 18 meditations while the 100% checklist needs 15 of 18; some sources present 15 as the trophy total, and the sources disagree, so aim for all 18.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.

steps.t: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing beside the bar.
Single source: this method comes from PowerPyx only and has not been confirmed by a second source.
Find the UFO easter egg — walk north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2am, alone.
A flashing car sometimes waits by the roadside; if it is not there, leave and come back, then follow the path into the woods toward the bright blue light.
Single source: this method comes from PowerPyx only and has not been confirmed by a second source.
Win 20 different races.
There are 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many to choose from.
Pick the 20 easiest locations first — any 20 of the 40 count.
Twenty wins is the trophy — spread them across the map so travel time stays low.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.

steps.t: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
Earliest after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) before you raise the heat.
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) is the easiest escape — police and helicopters cannot follow you inside.
It also pops automatically during bank vault robberies.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.t: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
Available after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Keep the wanted level flashing red/blue, not solid red heat.
If it has not popped after the third shop, rob a fourth; the pop can lag by about 30 seconds.
Three jewelry shops north of Vice City make a good run — they open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.

steps.t: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
You need the Dye Pack Jammer from the Chapter 3 mission “Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew)”.
Marked bills come from bank vaults and payday loans.
Sell them to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
One bank vault can pay up to $205,000, so a few vaults cover most of the total.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.

steps.t: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations in total.
There are 42 drone races across those 14 locations; the trophy wants a win at each location, not all 42 races.
Fly each location's race until you win it, then move on — one win per location is enough.
The same 14 locations are a line on the 100% checklist, so these wins count twice.
Spend $100,000 across all shops.
Fastest through weapons, car mods and tattoos (the priciest).
Shop counts: 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Spray, 24 Ammu-Nation, 67 clothing, 17 footwear, 18 hair & beauty, 11 tattoo and 15 electronics stores.
Spend while you kit out for other trophies — weapons and mods for the grinds count here too.
Purchase all 8 garage properties.
They cost about $160,000 in total.
Buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; the 4 story garages do NOT count.
Keep garage slots free: registering cars for On the Spot needs one empty slot per car.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.

steps.t: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
The app opens after the Chapter 2 mission “Moses”; bring a stolen car to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register.
Each car needs 1 empty garage slot.
From Chapter 3 you can also register standard tracker cars at a Pay 'n' Spray.
Ten registrations is the trophy — steal, respray, register, repeat, and keep a slot free for the next car.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.t: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming (slow-motion).
Each fish you catch adds about 10% to the Focus meter, and Adrenaline stretches its duration.
Use an assault rifle on a group of enemies, such as the guards at an illegal operation.
It does NOT work on soldiers, police or civilians — pick a gang crew as the target.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.

steps.t: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
You need the Snap Gun from the Chapter 3 mission “Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs” — it opens the locked back door without an alarm; kicking the door trips it.
Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, destroy the CCTV footage and switch the alarm off.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target.
Undetected is the whole trophy — if the alarm sounds, leave and try another store.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

steps.t: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
It pops automatically in the optional Chapter 4 mission “That's Where The Money Is…” — robbing the big bank vault there counts as an armored truck robbery.
Earlier option: ambush a truck near a bank in Vice City and stick a sticky bomb on its rear door.
The trophy pops only after you leave the red heat radius, so keep driving until the heat clears.
Complete 50 Challenges.
There are 80 challenges in total.
See and track them in Progress > Challenges.
The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50 if you are chasing the Platinum.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.

steps.t: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — steal a plane and fly off.
Take the big passenger plane attached to a boarding bridge at the departures terminal, easiest at gates E3/E4 — not the ones parked on the field.
Get into the cockpit, reverse the plane onto the runway and take off; the trophy pops about 1 km from the airport.
Save first — the police arrive fast.
One clean takeoff is all it takes — if the run fails, reload the save and try another gate.
Get into a Rhino tank — one sits on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station.
Get in through the gate or over the wall with the stunt jump near the south-east door, then shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
Save first, and note the dispute: PowerPyx puts Mile Zero in the south-west of the map, in Mariana County; the Goose Key claim is unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.

steps.t: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
Steal the blue Banshee from the showroom south of Vice City and drive it through the showroom window — you need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission “Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs”.
Single source: this method comes from PowerPyx only and has not been confirmed by a second source; only that blue Banshee counts (a GTA III easter egg).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.

steps.t: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — steal 3 valuables at Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn (a Gang Operation).

The three: a luxury watch (south-east office), the unique shotgun variant “Gutterball Moreland 850” (north-east corner table) and a safe (north-east corridor, cracked with a Sticky Bomb from Ammu-Nation).
The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you take the third item.
The items need not be taken at once — the robbery icon comes back after a long delay.
Reach maximum Strength with Jason AND Lucia at the same time.
You can start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when character switching opens; buy a gym membership and always bring your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
While one character trains, the partner finishes their workout automatically; check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon).
Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile.
Turn profile notifications on (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) so you can see each change.

Profiles run Professional (stealthy), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing), Psycho (mass killing) and Irredeemable — the last is PERMANENT if you go too far, and police get more aggressive, so avoid it.
It usually fills in passively while you chase the other trophies.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.

steps.t: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs in total.
There are 39 operations in all, and the 100% checklist wants all 39.
Operations show as yellow icons on the map as you approach; track them in Progress > Gangs.

Method unknown: PowerPyx writes “currently unknown (believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from Prologue)”, and other sources say the exact method remains unverified — do not chase a guessed method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.

steps.t: Method unknown: PowerPyx writes “currently unknown (believed to be from kicking people while driving a motorcycle)”, and other sources say the precise conditions remain under investigation — do not chase a guessed method.
